notes.title: Update 1 - Day 1 hot fixes
notes.content:
Hey guys thanks to everyone who reported bugs! I was able to get most of them with this update and I will fix more tomorrow.

If you run into any issues please let me know as soon as possible!

Whats new?
-Buffed Shotgun
-Buffed Semi Auto Rifle
-Buffed 1911 Pistol
-Buffed tommy gun
-Headshots are now detectable
-Fixed AI in "Amico Nostra"
-Fixed UI issues
-Added new stuff to the tutorial
-Added new entrances
